originalTitle: Veeva Systems (VEEV) Gains As Market Dips: What You Should Know
summary: The latest trading day saw Veeva Systems (VEEV) settling at $242.75, representing a +1.85% change from its previous close.
content:
Veeva Systems (VEEV) ended the recent trading session at $242.75, demonstrating a +1.85% change from the preceding day's closing price. This change outpaced the S&P 500's 0.69% loss on the day. Meanwhile, the Dow lost 0.22%, and the Nasdaq, a tech-heavy index, lost 1.33%.

Coming into today, shares of the provider of cloud-based software services for the life sciences industry had gained 20.73% in the past month. In that same time, the Medical sector gained 2.6%, while the S&P 500 gained 3.96%.

Analysts and investors alike will be keeping a close eye on the performance of Veeva Systems in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company's earnings report is set to go public on August 26, 2026. It is anticipated that the company will report an EPS of $2.22, marking a 11.56% rise compared to the same quarter of the previous year. At the same time, our most recent consensus estimate is projecting a revenue of $904.07 million, reflecting a 14.57% rise from the equivalent quarter last year.

For the annual period, the Zacks Consensus Estimates anticipate earnings of $9.05 per share and a revenue of $3.64 billion, signifying shifts of +11.73% and +13.96%, respectively, from the last year.

It is also important to note the recent changes to analyst estimates for Veeva Systems. Recent revisions tend to reflect the latest near-term business trends. With this in mind, we can consider positive estimate revisions a sign of optimism about the business outlook.

Based on our research, we believe these estimate revisions are directly related to near-term stock moves. To capitalize on this, we've crafted the Zacks Rank, a unique model that incorporates these estimate changes and offers a practical rating system.

Ranging from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), the Zacks Rank system has a proven, outside-audited track record of outperformance, with #1 stocks returning an average of +25% annually since 1988. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has witnessed an unchanged state. Veeva Systems is currently sporting a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

From a valuation perspective, Veeva Systems is currently exchanging hands at a Forward P/E ratio of 26.34. This expresses no noticeable deviation compared to the average Forward P/E of 26.34 of its industry.

Investors should also note that VEEV has a PEG ratio of 0.75 right now. This popular metric is similar to the widely-known P/E ratio, with the difference being that the PEG ratio also takes into account the company's expected earnings growth rate. VEEV's industry had an average PEG ratio of 1.73 as of yesterday's close.

The Medical Info Systems industry is part of the Medical sector. This industry currently has a Zacks Industry Rank of 97, which puts it in the top 40% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Don't forget to use Zacks.com to keep track of all these stock-moving metrics, and others, in the upcoming trading sessions.

chineseTitle: Veeva Systems (VEEV) 随着市场下跌而上涨：您应该知道什么
chineseSummary: 最近一个交易日，Veeva Systems (VEEV) 收于 242.75 美元，较前收盘价上涨 1.85%。
chineseContent:
Veeva Systems (VEEV) 最近交易日收盘价为 242.75 美元，较前一日收盘价上涨 1.85%。这一变化超过了标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.69% 的跌幅。与此同时，道指下跌 0.22%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 1.33%。

截至今天，这家生命科学行业云软件服务提供商的股价在过去一个月上涨了 20.73%。与此同时，医疗板块上涨 2.6%，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 3.96%。

分析师和投资者都将密切关注 Veeva Systems 在即将发布的收益披露中的表现。该公司将于2026年8月26日发布财报，预计每股收益为2.22美元，较上年同期增长11.56%。与此同时，我们最近的共识预测收入为 9.0407 亿美元，较去年同期增长 14.57%。

对于年度期间，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 9.05 美元，收入为 36.4 亿美元，分别较去年增加 11.73% 和 +13.96%。

同样重要的是要注意 Veeva Systems 分析师估计的最新变化。最近的修订往往反映最新的近期业务趋势。考虑到这一点，我们可以认为积极的估计修正是对业务前景乐观的迹象。

根据我们的研究，我们认为这些估计修正与近期股票走势直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们精心设计了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，融合了这些估计变化并提供了实用的评级系统。

从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），Zacks Rank 系统拥有经过验证的、经过外部审计的优异表现记录，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票平均每年回报率为 +25%。在过去 30 天里，Zacks 共识每股收益估计保持不变。 Veeva Systems 目前的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

从估值角度来看，Veeva Systems目前的远期市盈率为26.34。与行业平均远期市盈率 26.34 相比，这并没有明显的偏差。

投资者还应该注意，VEEV 目前的 PEG 比率为 0.75。这个流行的指标与广为人知的市盈率类似，不同之处在于，PEG比率还考虑了公司的预期盈利增长率。截至昨天收盘，VEEV 行业的平均 PEG 率为 1.73。

医疗信息系统行业是医疗行业的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 97，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 40%。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量我们行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
